_readme: Written by scripts/gen-concept-cars.py; read by the asset gallery.

models.name: kit-sprint
models.note: A kit coupe with a little more: a bonnet scoop, a raked spoiler on struts, flush head and tail lamps, slate windows all round.

models.name: kit-formula
models.note: A kit open-wheeler with a little more: side pods with dark intakes, an airbox behind a roll hoop, a front wing and a rear wing on struts.

models.name: kit-rally
models.note: A kit hatchback with a little more: a tall glasshouse, a roof scoop and roof spoiler, a pair of driving lamps on the front bumper.

models.name: kit-muscle
models.note: A kit muscle car with a little more: a long bonnet with a grey blower and dark scoop through it, a set-back cab, a ducktail, side pipes and fatter rear wheels.

models.name: kit-pickup
models.note: A kit pickup with a little more: an open bed with a crate in it, a roll bar with two lamps behind the cab.

models.name: kit-van
models.note: A kit micro van with a little more: a tall box with a band of slate windows, a roof rack with a suitcase strapped on.
